issue.title: Codex orphan sweep: retire byte-identical rollout collisions instead of keeping and re-warning on every launch

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by sase-1oj.6 note #4; triaged by the sase-1oj land agent.

**What happens now.** The Codex orphan sweep (`_sweep_orphaned_codex_shadow_homes` in `src/sase/llm_provider/_codex_home.py`, added by sase-1oj.5 / d6d8b2b942) rescues stray rollouts with `_move_regular_file_no_clobber`. When the destination already exists it logs `Codex shadow rollout collision at …` and returns False. `_try_delete_shadow_home` then logs `Keeping Codex shadow home …` and keeps the directory. This follows the epic plan's "fail toward keeping" invariant. On athena (sase-1oj.6 report `file:explicit:1e18c3d5d24ecf9a40c1fe61`, 2026-10-27) six SASE-managed, pid-dead shadow homes from 2026-07-19 are left (~0.8 MB). Each holds one `sessions/2026/07/19/rollout-*.jsonl` whose name already exists in `~/.codex/sessions`. Because they stay eligible, every Codex launch (~59/day) re-walks them and logs about 12 warnings. They also count toward the per-sweep `_ORPHAN_SWEEP_MAX_DIRS` budget.

**Proposal.**
- When the colliding destination is byte-identical to the source (same size and content, or the same inode), treat the source as already rescued: unlink it and let the home be deleted.
- Keep the shadow home only for a true content conflict.
- Optionally record kept homes (for example a marker file) so later sweeps skip them instead of re-warning on every launch.
- Add tests for the identical-collision and differing-collision cases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1oj plan deliberately specified "On a destination collision, log it and keep the shadow home" and "A name collision leaves the file where it is". Retiring identical duplicates changes that safety policy, so it needs the owner's triage rather than a silent change during the epic landing. The leftover is small (6 dirs, ~0.8 MB). The cost is per-launch log noise, not lost data.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1oj.6 proposed it after measuring athena: six dead July-19 Codex shadow homes survive every orphan sweep because of rescue-on-collision, and each launch re-logs them.
